target_customer: B2B companies and small sales teams that want outbound prospecting and meeting booking automated
problem: Outbound sales development is repetitive and costly; AiSDR uses generative AI to find prospects, write personalized email and LinkedIn outreach and book meetings.
business_model: Usage-based and subscription, pay as you go at $1.50 per person prospected, with team and managed-service plans

founders.name: Yuriy Zaremba
prior_employers: AXDRAFT (co-founder; general manager after acquisition by Onit)
previous_startups: AXDRAFT (YC W19, acquired by Onit in Dec 2020)
founders.background_notes: 8+ years in B2B sales per the YC page; grew AXDRAFT to $2M with founder-led sales.

founders.name: Oleg Zaremba
founders.background_notes: Education not given on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: In mid-2023 a GPT-based email writer with prospecting, sequencing and reply handling was mostly integration work on top of large language model APIs and email deliverability.

defensibility.rationale: Built on shared foundation models, with a crowded field of AI SDR products; the company itself says it relies on lessons from campaign data, which is a thin moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Many AI SDR competitors launched and incumbents added AI features; AiSDR remained independent as of the sources found.

market_need_then: Outbound sales is a large spend and generative AI made cheap personalization possible in 2023; AiSDR's YC launch post reported 24 customers within two months.

identity.mascot_or_character: Ami, the AI GTM agent, is the product persona but not a humanized mascot
identity.voice_and_tone: practical, data-driven, with yearly review blogs

branding.brand_signature: Strategy of making AiSDR the name for the AI sales category, with no mascot (company blog, May 2025)
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt badge and G2 badges shown on its site; trademark filings began Aug 2023.

brand_strength.rationale: A category-descriptive name that matches the search term AI SDR gives discoverability, and the company explicitly pursues category ownership, but competitors with similar names and categories dilute it.

outcome_analysis: AiSDR raised a $3M seed after YC Demo Day in November 2023, reported 4x revenue growth in 2024 and a team of 21, and launched the Ami agent. Founders were repeat founders with a prior YC exit. No shutdown, layoffs or acquisition were found. The category is crowded, so durability depends on product quality rather than structural moat.
notes: Seed of $3M reported by AIN and TechUkraine and by the company's about page; Silicon Canals headline says $2.7M, so the amount differs slightly by outlet. Prospeo claims $6M total, probably a double count. A later seed in Apr 2026 with no amount appears on an aggregator and is unverified. A Tracxn M&A offer in April 2025 is unverified. Competition list empty because the competitor search returned only 2026 vendor comparison pages. Founders' education is not given on the YC page.
